about: Working Podcasting 2.0 features from live sites, packaged for a coding agent to install. Read a recipe's manifest, then its README, before copying anything.

states.patched: a live-site file plus a named fix the site does not have
states.authored: written for this catalog; no site runs it

recipes.name: boostagram-keysend
recipes.summary: Split a boost across a <podcast:value> block's recipients and attach a bLIP-10 boostagram to each keysend payment, plus the decoder for reading inbound ones.

recipes.name: boostbox-client
recipes.summary: Store a boost's Podcasting 2.0 metadata in a BoostBox instance and get back a short URL for the payment description, with the API key held server-side.

recipes.name: chapters-json
recipes.summary: Parse a podcast:chapters JSON file, repairing the one real-world corruption that breaks JSON.parse on otherwise intact chapters, without ever rewriting a valid file.

recipes.name: lightning-wallet-payments
recipes.summary: Connect a browser Lightning wallet over WebLN or Nostr Wallet Connect, then pay a Lightning address, a bolt11 invoice or a keysend destination.

recipes.name: musicl-playlist-feed
recipes.summary: Write a musicL playlist feed (a list of songs from other feeds, as podcast:remoteItem tags) with a podcast:guid that never changes between builds, and read the remoteItems back out of any feed.

recipes.name: pc20-feed-validator
recipes.summary: A page that checks a podcast RSS feed against twenty Podcasting 2.0 namespace tags and reports what is present, missing or malformed.

recipes.name: podcast-feed-parser
recipes.summary: Parse a Podcasting 2.0 RSS feed into typed data: channel and items, value blocks and recipients, persons, funding, publisher, block, locked, images and transcripts. Tags it does not model are kept raw, so nothing is silently dropped.

recipes.name: podcast-index-client
recipes.summary: A minimal Podcast Index API client: signed requests, three lookups (podcast by guid, podcast by feed URL, episode by guid), and an answer that keeps 'not found' apart from 'could not ask', so a rate limit is never cached as a miss.

recipes.name: pwa-install-prompt
recipes.summary: An install-as-app banner handling Android's beforeinstallprompt and iOS Safari's Add-to-Home-Screen instructions separately, with session-scoped dismissal.

recipes.name: safe-feed-fetch
recipes.summary: Fetch a user-supplied feed, chapters or transcript URL on a server without opening an SSRF hole: every redirect hop re-checked, every resolved address checked, private and special-use IPv4 and IPv6 refused, and the body read under a byte cap.
